claims.claim: Cleopatra lived closer to the Moon landing than to the building of the Great Pyramid.
claims.source_checked: Sheisha et al. 2022 full text, Europe PMC fullTextXML PMC9477388 (www.ebi.ac.uk); Crossref api.crossref.org/works/10.1073/pnas.2202530119; Erdil et al. 2025 S2 Table (journals.plos.org supplementary file 10.1371/journal.pone.0314612.s005); Rosso 2021 full text, Europe PMC fullTextXML PMC8042289 (www.ebi.ac.uk); Crossref 10.1016/j.toxrep.2021.03.004; images-api.nasa.gov records ksc-69pc-442, as11-40-5903, as11-40-5877 (incl. KSC-as11-40-5877), as11-40-5874
claims.note: Her life 69-30 BC (Rosso: 'Cleopatra VII was born at 69 BC'; 'The queen committed suicide in August 30 BC'). Moon landing 20 July 1969 (NASA KSC-as11-40-5877: 'Armstrong and Aldrin landed on the Moon July 20, 1969'). Khufu's reign ends (Djedefra accession) at medians 2565-2603 BCE in Erdil S2 Table; even on Spence's low dates in Sheisha (Khafre accession '2448 ± 5 BCE') the pyramid is ~2,379 years before her birth vs 2,037 to Apollo 11; from her death 2,418 vs 1,998. Building began before completion, so 'building' only widens the gap. Holds for every point of her life and every chronology in the cited sources.

claims.claim: [Hook at second two] Viewer has heard 'Cleopatra lived closer to the Moon landing' (word 'landing' ends 2.32 s in the alignment) while seeing 'CLEOPATRA' / 'QUEEN OF EGYPT · 69–30 BC' (Look 1) or Waterhouse's painting with 'CLEOPATRA' and 'WATERHOUSE · IMAGINED' (Look 2).
claims.source_checked: src/generated/cleopatra-timeline.alignment.json word timings; claims 1 and 8
claims.note: What a viewer leaves with (Cleopatra was closer in time to Apollo 11 than to the pyramid's building) is the true form of the popular fact, not a distorted version; the painting is flagged 'IMAGINED' so it is not taken as her likeness. Nothing false is implied by the first two seconds.

claims.claim: The pyramid was finished around twenty-six hundred BC.
claims.source_checked: Sheisha et al. 2022 full text, Europe PMC fullTextXML PMC9477388 (www.ebi.ac.uk); Crossref api.crossref.org/works/10.1073/pnas.2202530119; Erdil et al. 2025 S2 Table (journals.plos.org supplementary file 10.1371/journal.pone.0314612.s005)
claims.note: No cited source gives a completion year; the line dates completion by the end of Khufu's reign. Sheisha calls it 'the Great Pyramid of Giza (Khufu Pyramid)' and describes the 'construction of the pyramids of kings Khufu, Khafre, and Menkaure' within their reigns; Erdil S2 Table gives Djedefra's (Khufu's successor) accession medians 2565, 2577, 2586, 2603, 2603 BCE across OK-P1..P5, and Erdil concludes 'the Low Chronology is no longer empirically supported'. 'Around 2600' rounds 2565-2603 fairly. Note: 'finished by the end of Khufu's reign' is an inference the cited sources support only implicitly (built for and during his reign); the SOURCES block says so openly.
